translations.web: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.
translations.bsb: Simply let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes,’ and your ‘No,’ ‘No.’ Anything more comes from the evil one.
translations.kjv: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
translations.asv: But let your speech be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: and whatsoever is more than these is of the evil one.
